name: id-card
title: ID Card
author: D2 Studio
description: An event badge on a D2 strap: a portrait, name, role and a short about, with contact links at the foot. The strap is a rope under gravity, so drag the card and it swings; click it and it turns over to a printed back. The faces are painted on a canvas from the card's own palette and repainted when the theme flips, and the links stay real links, with a keyboard plate under the card for screen readers. Give its parent a height.
